sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT p.market_ticker) AS settled_markets, count(DISTINCT regexp_replace(p.market_ticker, '-[^-]*$', '')) AS settled_events FROM positions p WHERE p.raw_json ? 'settled_time' AND p.market_ticker IN (SELECT f.market_ticker FROM fills f JOIN live_orders o ON o.kalshi_order_id = f.kalshi_order_id WHERE o.strategy = 'Alimm1' AND o.action = 'buy')
